razonamiento: The diagram illustrates Euler Hermes's modernization architecture migrating data from an on-premises legacy IBM DB2 database into AWS (DynamoDB and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch). The architecture consists of two primary pipelines: a batch initialization flow and a real-time CDC synchronization flow. In the batch path, AWS DMS copies data from IBM DB2 to S3. An ephemeral Amazon EMR cluster runs Spark ETL jobs to clean, validate, and load the data into both DynamoDB and Elasticsearch. In the real-time path, DMS captures DB2 change logs and publishes events to Amazon Kinesis. A Node.js Lambda function consumes the Kinesis stream and updates DynamoDB. DynamoDB Streams then triggers a second Node.js Lambda function, which propagates the updates to Elasticsearch. Above Elasticsearch, a search API is drawn and described as the interface used by clients and frontends.
nombre: Euler Hermes Legacy DB2 Migration and Real-Time Sync to DynamoDB and Elasticsearch
